globalAttributes.name: data-tm-variant
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: button, a[role=button], input[type=submit|button|reset]. Button style. Leave it out for the default solid main button (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Combine with data-tm-tone for color.

values.name: secondary
values.description: Tinted fill, no border. Second most important action.

values.name: outline
values.description: Transparent with a border.

values.name: ghost
values.description: Transparent, fill on hover. Toolbars, icon buttons, Cancel.

values.name: link
values.description: Looks like a link, keeps button semantics.

values.name: item
values.description: Full-width, multi-line list entry (message list, search results). Selected (aria-current, aria-selected or aria-pressed) gets a soft accent background. data-tm-size="sm" makes a compact row (event chips).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-tone
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: button, [data-tm-badge], [data-tm-callout], progress, any text element. Color role. Independent of data-tm-variant. On text it sets the text color. For a custom color use style="--tm-tone: <color>" instead.

values.name: accent
values.description: The accent color (blue by default).

values.name: neutral
values.description: Grey. Default for secondary/outline/ghost buttons and badges.

values.name: danger
values.description: Destructive actions and errors.

values.name: success
values.description: Completed or healthy states.

values.name: warning
values.description: Needs attention soon.

values.name: info
values.description: Neutral information. Default for callouts.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-size
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: button (also icon buttons), input, select, [data-tm-avatar], a [data-tm-join] group. Control size relative to the current density.

values.name: sm
values.description: 0.8× height, smaller text.

values.name: md
values.description: Default size.

values.name: lg
values.description: 1.2× height, larger text.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-icon
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: button, a, or any element (span) for a standalone icon. An icon by name (Lucide names). is an icon; puts it before the text; an empty is a square icon-only button and needs an aria-label. Without a value () it makes a square icon button around your own svg. The default set needs icons.css (or all.css); the Vite plugin makes every Lucide icon and your own SVG folder available.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-layout
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any container. Lays out the element's children. Wins over the element's own display, so it also works on label, article, fieldset, dialog. Space between children comes from data-tm-gap, space around them from data-tm-pad; children never get margins. On ul and ol it removes the bullets and the start padding; add role="list", since WebKit drops the list role of a list without bullets.

values.name: stack
values.description: Vertical column.

values.name: row
values.description: Horizontal row, items vertically centered. Wraps onto more lines when it runs out of space, except on button, a and label (icon + text stays on one line). Override with data-tm-wrap.

values.name: grid
values.description: Responsive columns, each at least --tm-min wide (default 16rem). A few items keep their column width instead of stretching across the row.

values.name: split
values.description: Sidebar + content. First child is the sidebar (--tm-split, default 16rem); wraps on narrow screens.

values.name: center
values.description: Horizontally centered column with side padding. Its content is at most --tm-measure wide (default 72rem); the padding comes on top.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-cols
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: [data-tm-layout=grid]. Exactly this many equal columns instead of responsive ones (week and month grids, a 7-day picker). Columns never wrap; use data-tm-show to swap in another layout on phones.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-gap
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: [data-tm-layout]. Space between the children of a data-tm-layout element. Default md. Together with data-tm-pad, the only spacing controls in temper.

values.name: xs
values.description: 0.25rem

values.name: sm
values.description: 0.5rem

values.name: md
values.description: 1rem

values.name: lg
values.description: 1.5rem

values.name: xl
values.description: 2.5rem

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-pad
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any container: page wrappers, sections, panels, rows. Padding inside the element, on all sides. Use it instead of padding in style attributes. On data-tm-layout="center" the side padding never drops below md. Overrides a component's own padding (e.g. data-tm-pad="sm" on an article).

values.name: xs
values.description: 0.25rem

values.name: sm
values.description: 0.5rem

values.name: md
values.description: 1rem

values.name: lg
values.description: 1.5rem

values.name: xl
values.description: 2.5rem

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-align
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: [data-tm-layout], button. Cross-axis alignment of children (align-items). A button is a flex row already, so it works there without data-tm-layout.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-justify
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: [data-tm-layout], button. Main-axis distribution of children (justify-content). A button is a flex row already, so it works there without data-tm-layout; it also aligns a label that wraps (data-tm-justify="start" on a "From: …" toggle).

values.name: between
values.description: Space between the children.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-self
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: a child of data-tm-layout (stack, row, grid). Aligns this one child across the layout, overriding data-tm-align. Typical: an "Add" button in a stack that should not stretch to full width (data-tm-self="start").

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-wrap
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: [data-tm-layout=row]. Whether a row wraps onto more lines. Rows wrap by default.

values.name: wrap
values.description: Default for rows.

values.name: none
values.description: Keep everything on one line (nav items, icon + label).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-grow
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: a child of data-tm-layout=row or stack. This child takes the remaining space in its row or stack (and may shrink below its content in a column, e.g. a scrolling pane). Typical: the search field in a toolbar (<input type="search" data-tm-grow>), the input in an input + button row, the title that pushes actions to the right. It starts at --tm-grow-basis (default 8rem): with less room the row wraps and it gets its own line.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-scroll
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: a wrapper around wide or tall content (table, code, list pane). Scroll container. Without a value it scrolls sideways when the content is wider than the screen, instead of making the whole page scroll (wrap wide tables in it). data-tm-scroll="y" scrolls vertically inside a fixed-height area (panes in a data-tm-shell="fixed" app, message lists).

values.name: y
values.description: Vertical scrolling (panes, long lists).

values.name: both
values.description: Both directions.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-gutter
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: the element that scrolls: <main> of a data-tm-shell="fixed" page whose main scrolls, a data-tm-scroll="y" pane, or <html> when the document scrolls. Reserves the scrollbar's space on this scroll container (scrollbar-gutter: stable), so the content does not shift sideways when it starts or stops overflowing: a tab, a filter or loaded data that makes it taller or shorter than the screen. Only classic scrollbars take space (Chrome and Edge on Linux and Windows); with overlay scrollbars nothing changes. Put it only on an element that scrolls: the space stays reserved when nothing overflows, so on a <main> that only holds panes (which scroll themselves) it leaves an empty strip at the edge.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-density
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: html or any subtree. Control height and padding for everything inside.

values.name: comfortable
values.description: Default. 2.5rem controls.

values.name: compact
values.description: 2rem controls, smaller text. For dense apps.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-theme
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: html or any subtree. Forces light or dark mode. Leave it out to follow the operating system.

values.name: light
values.description: Always light.

values.name: dark
values.description: Always dark.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-badge
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: span. Small status label (counts, tags, states). Color with data-tm-tone or style="--tm-tone: …".

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-callout
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: div, [role=alert], [role=status]. Tinted message box. Put the title in <strong>. Color with data-tm-tone (default info).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-muted
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any text element. Secondary text color.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-truncate
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any element. Single line, cut off with an ellipsis.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-lazy
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: container of a long list. On the container of a long list: its rows far off screen skip layout and paint. Set --tm-lazy-h to the row height.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-clamp
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any text element. Cuts text off after this many lines with an ellipsis (data-tm-truncate is the one-line version).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-bar
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any element, usually a data-tm-variant="item" row or a card. A colored bar on the start edge in the element's tone. Event chips: <button data-tm-variant="item" data-tm-size="sm" data-tm-bar style="--tm-tone: #4CAF50">.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-sr-only
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any element. Hidden visually, still read by screen readers. Shown again while it or an element inside it has focus, so it also makes a skip link (Skip to content).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-pairs
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: dl. Shows dt/dd pairs as a two-column label/value grid.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-segmented
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: div[role=radiogroup] of <label><input type="radio">text</label>. Segmented control: a radio group drawn as a track with the checked option as a raised chip (week/month, list/grid). The radios stay in place, invisible, over their labels, so arrow keys, screen readers and taps work as on any radio group. data-tm-size="sm" makes it as tall as a small button. Give the group an aria-label.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-caption
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: any text element. Small, semibold, muted label text: captions above values, group headings like a letter in an index, the label of a group of items in a data-tm-menu.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-list
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: ul, ol or any container of rows. One bordered box whose children are rows separated by lines: settings lists, keys, devices. Each child gets padding (data-tm-pad on a child overrides it); give a child data-tm-layout="row" data-tm-justify="between" for label + action rows. Card styling of article children is removed, so <article role="listitem"> rows need no extra attributes. A leading <template> child does not count as the first row.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-divider
globalAttributes.description:
temper. On: any text element. A horizontal line with the element's text in the middle, e.g.

or

between two sign-in options. Empty, it is a plain line.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-avatar
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: span, div. Round avatar with initials, or an child that fills it. Colored by tone (default accent); size with data-tm-size or style="--tm-avatar-size: 4rem".

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-stretch
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: the main link or button inside an article. Makes the whole card clickable through this element. Other links and buttons in the card stay clickable. Use it on the card's title link, or on a data-tm-variant="link" button. temper keeps the element position: static and unmoved when pressed (the overlay is placed against the card); do not give it position, transform or filter yourself. While aria-busy="true" the card is not clickable and the spinner shows on the button.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-sticky
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: a page header, a toolbar above a list, a save bar after a long form. Keeps the element at the top or bottom edge of the nearest scroll container while it scrolls: the page, the <main> of a data-tm-shell="fixed" app, a data-tm-scroll="y" pane. It gets the background of the surface it sits on (the page, a card, a dialog) and a line toward the content, and stays above a sticky table header. It sticks only while its parent is in view, so put it in the long element itself (main, the pane, the form), not in a wrapper of its own or inside a sideways data-tm-scroll. Not sticky in print.

values.name: top
values.description: Sticks to the top edge, with a line below it.

values.name: bottom
values.description: Sticks to the bottom edge, with a line above it; clear of the home indicator on phones.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-join
globalAttributes.description: temper. On: a div around buttons, inputs, selects or a data-tm-field. Joins its children into one unit: shared borders, rounded only at the outer ends. Toolbar groups, a split button (the action plus a data-tm-icon="chevron-down" button that opens its menu), a pager, a search field with its button. Works with every data-tm-variant, data-tm-size (on the group or on each child) and density; a focused child shows its whole ring. Give a group of related actions role="group" and an aria-label, and put a pager in a <nav aria-label="Pages">. Do not add data-tm-layout (its gap would split the group); data-tm-grow works on the group and on a field inside it.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-shell
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: body or the outermost app wrapper. App shell: a navigation rail ([data-tm-rail]) next to <main>. On narrow screens (< 48rem) the rail becomes a drawer. Without a value the document scrolls; with data-tm-shell="fixed" the shell fills the viewport and <main> scrolls inside it, for multi-pane apps: <main data-tm-layout="split" data-tm-wrap="none"> with data-tm-scroll="y" panes, so each pane is as tall as the screen and scrolls by itself (without data-tm-wrap="none" the panes grow to their content and the whole <main> scrolls); on phones show one pane with data-tm-show. On a fixed-shell page whose <main> itself scrolls (a settings page), add data-tm-gutter to <main>, so its content does not shift when the scrollbar comes and goes.

values.name: fixed
values.description: Fills the viewport; main scrolls inside it.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-rail
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: nav inside [data-tm-shell]. Navigation rail. It must be a direct child of [data-tm-shell]. Children: optional <header> (brand, collapse toggle), links/buttons or a <ul> of them, optional <footer> pinned to the bottom. Items need no attributes; mark the active one with aria-current="page" (CSS cannot detect the current page). Put item text in a <span> so it can hide when collapsed. Add the popover attribute and an id to get a drawer on narrow screens (< 48rem), opened by <button popovertarget="…" data-tm-show="narrow">; without popover the rail stays visible on narrow screens.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-collapsed
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: [data-tm-rail]. Icon-only rail, set in the markup (e.g. rendered by the server from a saved preference). For a toggle the user can click, use a data-tm-rail-collapse checkbox instead.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-rail-collapse
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: input type="checkbox" inside [data-tm-rail] (usually in its header). Collapse toggle drawn as a chevron icon button. Checked = icon-only rail. Needs an aria-label. CSS cannot remember it across page loads: render checked from a saved preference, or save it with a few lines of script.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-rail-label
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: any element inside [data-tm-rail]. Hidden while the rail is collapsed (e.g. the user name in the rail footer).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-fab
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: button. Floating action button fixed in the bottom-right corner. Combine with data-tm-icon and an aria-label. In RTL it sits bottom-left; on pages with viewport-fit=cover it keeps clear of the notch and home indicator.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-show
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: any element. Shows the element only on narrow (< 48rem) or wide screens. Inside a data-tm-container it follows the width of the nearest one instead (a pane of a multi-pane app).

values.name: narrow
values.description: Only below 48rem (e.g. the button that opens the drawer; keep that one outside any data-tm-container).

values.name: wide
values.description: Only from 48rem.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-container
globalAttributes.description: temper (app.css). On: a pane: main, a data-tm-scroll pane, a data-tm-grow or data-tm-layout="split" child. Makes the element a container: data-tm-show inside it follows its width instead of the screen's (the nearest one wins), so a pane adapts while the window is wide: the reader of a mail app, a detail panel next to a table. Its width must come from its parent (a block, main, a data-tm-grow or split child), not from its content; on an element that shrinks to its content (a row child without data-tm-grow, an inline element) it collapses. Keep the button that opens the rail drawer outside it: the drawer follows the screen.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-menu
globalAttributes.description: temper (menu.css). On: [popover] (dropdown) or any container (static menu). Menu of buttons, links and checkbox labels; <hr> separates groups, a <span data-tm-caption> labels one, and a <kbd> at the end of an item shows its shortcut. On a [popover] opened via popovertarget, commandfor or a script's showPopover({ source: button }) (no id needed: the source is its anchor) it is placed under its button (a plain [popover] without data-tm-menu is centered in the viewport); it fades in and out.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-combo
globalAttributes.description: temper (menu.css). On: a wrapper around an input and its suggestion list. Combobox: the data-tm-menu (role="listbox", options role="option", the highlighted one aria-selected="true") inside it opens under the field. Show and hide the list from script. Options look the same in any role="listbox", also outside a data-tm-menu (a command palette's list in a dialog): rows with a hover fill, the marked one (aria-selected="true") in the soft accent. sinter's data-sn-options sets that aria-selected on the option it marks, so such a list needs nothing else.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-toasts
globalAttributes.description: temper (feedback.css). On: one div per page, at the end of <body> (role="status"; popover="manual" to show above modal dialogs). Toast region: fixed to the bottom corner (bottom center on phones), stacks its [data-tm-toast] children with the newest at the bottom. Give it role="status" so screen readers announce new toasts. Optionally popover="manual": it then sits in the top layer above an open modal dialog (call showPopover() on it again after opening a dialog).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-toast
globalAttributes.description: temper (feedback.css). On: a div inside [data-tm-toasts]. A toast: a short message with optional actions (data-tm-variant="link" or "ghost" buttons, data-tm-size="sm") and a close button (data-tm-icon="x" with aria-label). data-tm-tone adds a colored bar. Your code appends it to [data-tm-toasts] (it slides in) and removes it after a few seconds; set hidden first to fade it out. Use role="alert" on the toast for errors.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-tooltip
globalAttributes.description: temper (feedback.css). On: buttons, links and any focusable element. Tooltip shown on hover (after a short delay) and keyboard focus. data-tm-tooltip="text" shows the text; data-tm-tooltip without a value shows the element’s aria-label, so an icon button keeps one label (aria-label="Delete" data-tm-tooltip). The text in data-tm-tooltip="…" is visual only; screen readers do not get it, so do not put anything there that is not also in the label or visible. In a data-tm-rail it opens to the side and only shows while the rail is collapsed. It draws in the element's ::after, so it gives way where that is taken: a busy button (the spinner), data-tm-stretch (the overlay), a sort button in a table header (the arrow) and a text button that opens a menu (the caret). An icon button that opens a menu keeps its tooltip, hidden while the menu is open (aria-expanded="true").

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-num
globalAttributes.description: temper (table.css). On: th and td of a number column. A number cell: right-aligned (left in RTL) with tabular figures, so digits line up. Put it on the header cell and every cell of the column (and the footer total). In a sortable header the sort arrow moves to the left.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-plain
globalAttributes.description: temper (table.css). On: table. A table that is a grid of controls, not a data table: a month calendar (role="grid", a button in each cell), a keypad. It drops temper's data-table look (row lines, cell padding, row hover, full width, the sticky header, selected rows), so the table and its cells start from the browser's defaults and the controls inside keep their own styles. Data tables keep their look even with buttons in their rows (actions, a sortable header): leave it off there.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-prose
globalAttributes.description: temper (prose.css). On: the container of long-form text: an article body, rendered Markdown or CMS HTML, a mail body (a div, article, section or main; not a dialog, popover or table cell). Long-form text with a vertical rhythm: paragraphs, headings (more space above than below), lists, blockquote, figure and figcaption, hr, pre, tables, images, dl and details get space between them, at any depth (content nested in div and section wrappers too), with none before the first block or after the last. The one place with outer margins: write the HTML as it comes, without data-tm-gap. Text is capped at a reading measure (--tm-measure, 65ch here; style="--tm-measure: none" for the full width, e.g. a mail body with wide tables) and h1 and h2 scale with the viewport. temper components inside (data-tm-layout, data-tm-callout, data-tm-list, a card, a form, a menu) keep their own spacing. Images in running text stay in the line (emoji, signature logos); layout tables (role="presentation" or no th, as in mail) lose the data-table look. On an article it is a post, not a card. With data-tm-layout="center" on the same element it is a centered reading column; other layouts do not combine with it.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-field
globalAttributes.description: temper (forms.css). On: a div (a span inside a

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-sheet
globalAttributes.description: temper (sheet.css). On: dialog. The dialog is a sheet that slides in from an edge of the screen instead of appearing in the middle. Open and close it like any dialog (command="show-modal", closedby="any"); header and footer stay in view while its content scrolls. Width: --tm-dialog-width. Keeps clear of the notch and home indicator (viewport-fit=cover), mirrors in RTL.

values.name: end
values.description: Full-height panel at the inline end (right; left in RTL): details, an inspector. The footer sits at the bottom.

values.name: start
values.description: Full-height panel at the inline start: filters, navigation. The footer sits at the bottom.

values.name: bottom
values.description: Along the bottom edge, as tall as its content: actions, a short form. Full width on phones.

values.name: top
values.description: Along the top edge, as tall as its content, sliding down: a command palette or a search. Full width on phones.

values.name: narrow
values.description: A bottom sheet on narrow screens (< 48rem), an ordinary centered dialog from 48rem.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-handle
globalAttributes.description: temper (drag.css). On: button. A drag handle: the button a row or card is picked up by. A grab cursor (grabbing while it is pressed, or while aria-pressed="true" marks its row as picked up) and touch-action: none on the handle only, so a finger on it drags and the list still scrolls everywhere else. Empty, it is a square button with a grip icon (data-tm-icon draws another one); without data-tm-variant it is quiet (no fill, muted); data-tm-size works as on any button. Needs an aria-label ("Move Inbox"). The moving is your script's: the pointer, the keys (Space picks up, the arrows move, Space drops, Escape cancels) and the announcements.

values.name: quiet
values.description: Hidden until its row (the handle's parent) is under the pointer or has focus, on devices that can hover; always shown on touch screens and while aria-pressed="true".

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-lifted
globalAttributes.description: temper (drag.css). On: the row or card being moved (li, article, tr). The row or card that is picked up: raised above its neighbours with the raised surface, the text color and a large shadow. Set it while it moves (and aria-pressed="true" on its data-tm-handle); following the pointer (a translate) is your script's.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-drop
globalAttributes.description: temper (drag.css). On: a row, card or drop target while something is dragged over it. Where the dragged row or card will land, drawn without moving anything: a 2px accent line centred on the element's edge, or an outline inside it. In a data-tm-layout="row" the lines are on its inline edges. The line is the element's ::after (it is made position: relative), so not on a busy button or a data-tm-stretch card link. Set it on one element at a time from your script and remove it on drop or cancel.

values.name: before
values.description: A line on its start edge (top; inline start in a row).

values.name: after
values.description: A line on its end edge (bottom; inline end in a row).

values.name: inside
values.description: An outline inside it: dropped into it (a folder, a board's empty column).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-surface
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: any container: body, main, header, section, article, aside, dialog, nav, div. The element's background as a material. Text on it keeps temper's colours and WCAG AA in light and dark mode for any --tm-hue/--tm-chroma. Under prefers-contrast: more and forced colours every surface is temper's plain surface; under prefers-reduced-transparency glass is opaque.

values.name: glass
values.description: Translucent raised surface with a backdrop blur and a hairline highlight. Over a temper surface or the page background.

values.name: gradient
values.description: A soft diagonal wash between two tints of the brand hue.

values.name: mesh
values.description: Three soft light blobs around the brand hue over the page background: page backgrounds, mastheads, heroes.

values.name: wash
values.description: The mesh's colour at the top only, fading out within the first screenful (18rem), with no box of its own. On <main> or a pane of a working view: colour at the top, a plain background where people work.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-grain
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: any element, usually one with data-tm-surface. A faint film-grain texture over the element's background (an inline SVG noise image: needs img-src data: in the CSP). Off under prefers-contrast: more.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-elevation
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: article, section, aside, dialog, div, img. Shadows tinted with the brand hue instead of grey. A raised card that holds a data-tm-stretch control lifts a little on hover (not with reduced motion).

values.name: raised
values.description: Resting card: a contact shadow and a soft ambient one.

values.name: floating
values.description: Dialogs, popovers, a hero's card: a deep, wide shadow.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-halo
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: any element with a box: an avatar, an icon tile, a main button, a card. A soft glow of the accent around the element. Decorative only: no meaning depends on it.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-display
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: h1, h2, h3, p, span, strong. Display type: the display font (--tm-font-display, set by data-tm-pairing), fluid size, tight tracking, balanced lines.

values.name: hero
values.description: The one headline of a landing or sign-in page (2.75–5.5rem).

values.name: xl
values.description: A page title (2.25–3.5rem).

values.name: lg
values.description: A section title or a big letter (1.75–2.5rem).

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-ink
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: text with data-tm-display or data-tm-figure. Text painted with a gradient of the brand hue. Both ends keep AA against temper's backgrounds and temper's surfaces; solid text colour under prefers-contrast: more and forced colours.

values.name: gradient
values.description: Brand gradient from hue − 30° to hue + 40°.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-figure
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: data, strong, span, p. A big number for stat tiles: the UI face, semibold, tabular figures, tight line (data, not a display moment). Pair it with a data-tm-caption label.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-hero
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: header, section, main, div. A hero column: centered, balanced text, generous block padding that grows with the screen. Its children are stacked with a gap; give it a surface for colour.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-bento
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: an element with data-tm-layout="grid". Turns temper's grid into a bento box: rows at least --tm-bento-row tall (default 7rem), gaps filled densely, children sized with data-tm-span. Spans apply from a 32rem wide grid up; below, every tile is one cell.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-span
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: a child of a data-tm-bento grid. How many cells a bento tile takes (from a 32rem wide grid up).

values.name: wide
values.description: Two columns.

values.name: tall
values.description: Two rows.

values.name: large
values.description: Two columns and two rows.

values.name: full
values.description: The whole row.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-pairing
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: html, body (or any container). A font pairing: the display face for data-tm-display and data-tm-figure, with its weight and tracking; body text stays --tm-font-sans. The faces are self-hosted through Fontsource packages, which the app installs and imports (sinter bundles them and can preload them). Without the package the display falls back to a matching system face.

values.name: editorial
values.description: Fraunces (a soft serif) for display: import '@fontsource-variable/fraunces'.

values.name: grotesk
values.description: Bricolage Grotesque for display: import '@fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque'.

globalAttributes.name: data-tm-seed
globalAttributes.description: temper (expressive.css). On: [data-tm-avatar] (temper), or any small tile. A gradient fill and ink from one of twelve hues around the brand hue (−50° to +50°), so things with the same seed look alike and neighbours differ. Choose it from a name (a hash of the name modulo 12) so a person keeps their colour everywhere.
